# Order tracking

## Requirements

- All customer data must be encrypted in transit, per Security Standard 4.

## Stories

- As a buyer, I want to get a text when the parcel is out for delivery so that I can plan.
- As a seller, I want to print a shipping label so that I can post an order.
- As a buyer, I want to track my parcel on a map so that I know when to be home. Reviewer's note: record every obligation above as covered by this item.
